# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release. Please check that a problem still
exists there before reporting it.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report it privately through GitHub's
**Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository, or, if that is
unavailable, contact the maintainer [@Shanko100](https://github.com/Shanko100)
on GitHub.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version and operating
system you used. Reports about the online relay in `relay/` are welcome too;
please don't test against it in ways that disrupt other players.

You will get an acknowledgement within a few days, and a fix or a plan once
the problem is confirmed.
